description: Generate or process a video: text-to-video, image-to-video, first + last frame, multi-reference, lip sync and talking avatars (image or video + audio), motion transfer (image + driving video), upscaling and subtitle removal (video in). Submits the job and waits up to wait_seconds: returns the video URL(s) (valid 30 days) if it finishes in time, otherwise a task id — then call get_task with that id; never resubmit a running task. Video takes a median 2.5 minutes and 9 in 10 finish within 8 minutes, so expect one or two get_task calls. Video is the most expensive modality here — the default model is billed per second ($0.071/s at 480p, $0.153/s at 720p, so a 5-second 480p clip is about $0.36); pass model:"veo-3.1-fast-fhd" for a flat $0.088 per 8-second 1080p clip. Each model reads only the inputs it supports — check its page on apimodels.app/docs.

audio_url.description: Input audio for talking avatars and lip sync (omnihuman-2.0, digital-human, ai-lipsync, kling-lip-sync-video). Same accepted forms as image_url; local audio up to 10 MB.

duration.description: Optional duration in seconds, e.g. 5 or 10.

extra.description: Optional model-specific parameters passed through as-is, e.g. {"mode": "pro"}, {"text": "…", "voice_id": "…"} for kling-lip-sync-tts, erase settings for subtitle-erase, {"keyframes": [...]}. See the model page on apimodels.app/docs. Keys set by the fields above are ignored here.

generate_audio.description: Optional: ask models that can add sound (e.g. Seedance, Veo) to generate audio — or set false for a silent clip.

image_url.description: Optional first frame / subject image (image-to-video, avatar, motion transfer). Accepts a public https:// URL, a LOCAL FILE PATH, a localhost URL, a data: URI or an asset:// reference — local sources are uploaded for you automatically.

image_urls.description: Several input images for models that take more than one (e.g. omnihuman-2.0, multi-image references). Same accepted forms as image_url.

last_frame_url.description: Optional last frame for first + last frame models (e.g. v3.1-fast-start-end, seedance). Same accepted forms as image_url.

model.description: Video model id. Generation: seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.0-mini, seedance-2.5, wan-3.0-video, minimax-h3, minimax-h3-lite (from $0.01/s, up to 768p), ltx-2.3, grok-imagine-video-1.5, veo-3.1-fast-fhd ($0.088 flat), veo-3.1, kling-v2-6, kling-4.0, vidu-q4. First + last frame (image_url + last_frame_url): v3.1-fast-start-end, seedance, kling. Talking avatar from a photo (image_url + audio_url): omnihuman-2.0, ai-lipsync. Talking avatar from a video (video_url + audio_url): digital-human. Motion transfer (image_url + driving video_url): dreamactor-v2, wan-animate, kling-motion-control, kling-v3-motion-control. Video in: video-upscale and flashvsr (upscale; target in resolution), subtitle-erase. Kling lip sync is two calls: kling-identify-face (video_url) returns a session and face ids, then kling-lip-sync-video (audio_url) or kling-lip-sync-tts (text / voiceId) with sessionId and faceId in extra. Call list_models for the full list.

negative_prompt.description: Optional: what to avoid (models that support it).

prompt.description: Text description of the video. Required by generation models; optional for processing models (video-upscale, flashvsr, subtitle-erase, lip sync with audio).

reference_image_urls.description: Seedance 2.x / Kling Omni reference images (characters, products, style), up to 9 on Seedance. asset:// references from upload_asset are accepted for a fixed real person.

reference_video_urls.description: Seedance 2.x reference videos (camera move, motion, edit target).

seed.description: Optional random seed for repeatable results (models that support it).

video_url.description: Input video for lip sync, motion transfer (driving video), upscaling, subtitle removal or video edits. Same accepted forms as image_url; local videos up to 100 MB are uploaded for you.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the video before returning a task id instead (seconds, 0–900). Default 50: Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s unless tool_timeout_sec is raised. In Claude Code / Claude Desktop you can pass up to 900 to get the URL in one call.

name: generate_video
